on_screen: AI Aapki Naukri Kha Jayega Ya Nayi Naukri Dega?

goal:
- India mein AI ki wajahse jobs mei badlave ho rahen hain. Automation aur augmentation ke ek saath, new AI careers bhi ban rahe hai.
- Machine learning se AI routine aur complex tasks perform karti hai, jo employment landscape ko dynamically change kar sakti hai.

title_hi: जॉब्स पे इम्पैक्ट: रिस्क और ओपोर्ट्यूनिटी
on_screen: Jobs pe impaikt: risk aur oportyuniti
Jobs pe impaikt: risk aur oportyuniti
goal:
- Informal sector mein workers ke job displacement hone ka risk maximum hai kyunki skills ki kami hoti hai.
- Automation manufacturing, logistics aur administrative jobs par zyada impact karta hai.  2030 tak 30% jobs automated ho sakti hain.

title_hi: फ्यूचर की तैयार: स्किल और एडैप्टेबिलिटी
on_screen: Phyuchar ki taiyar: skil aur edaiptebiliti
Phyuchar ki taiyar: skil aur edaiptebiliti
goal:
- AI ki wajahse coding, data analysis aur critical thinking skills ka importance bad raha hai.
- India ko AI benefits leverage karne ke liye infrastructure aur skilled workforce develop karna padega.  Skill development initiatives bahut zaroori hain.
- AI se jo jobs lost ho sakti hain, uske saath-साथ new opportunities bhi create honge - ek balanced approach sahi hoga.
